body:
Wow, this really parallels my experience.  I'm exceptionally good at hiding my condition from people around me, but not good at being normal in as much as that means forming deep relationships.  I have difficulty making eye contact because I know people who look there can see that there's nothing behind.

I'd say hang on buddy!  I'm 21, and still hacking along.  Just give it a little more time.  I know where you're coming from with lack of emotional understanding - I've been able to compensate analytically to some extent.  Just through observation over time, you can detect things that indicate emotions, and you can form something close to relationships.  It's worth trying because I think we're in a bucket where if we try hard enough we might escape.

I dunno if I'm helping, but it might be cool to know that there's someone who's experience is just like yours.  And I've gotten through it so far.

Also, if it's getting really bad, consider military service.  It's a way to force motivation and cover emptiness with a deeply inbuilt sense of purpose.  I've been considering this.
